title: Memory Standard note (mm)
description: A single memory note as exposed by the Memory Standard Protocol (mm). Any compliant writer produces these fields; any compliant reader consumes them. The canonical on-disk representation is MEMORY.md (index) + memories/<topic>.md (detail), addressed by mm://<memoryId>/<topic> URIs.

topic.description: Portable ASCII slug used as the URI segment and detail filename.

memoryId.description: The memory id used in mm://<memoryId>/<topic> URIs.

summary.description: One-line summary stored in the index.

file.description: Relative detail-file path with POSIX separators, e.g. memories/alpha.md.

updated.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last write.

bodyChars.description: Body length in Unicode code points at the time of the last write.

writeBudget.description: The per-write character budget the body was admitted under.

entryBody.description: Free-form body lines that live inside the index entry (preserved verbatim).

missingFile.description: True when the index references a detail file that does not exist.
